commands.switch_defaults: one-sentence platform-scope default switch over all three shared repositories: plan/apply(CAS+checkpoint)/verify/revert; never edits a shared current.json, never another platform (requirement #3 / ADR-7; 3.0 S-P2 adds kind software)
commands.version_impact: read-only reverse-dependency (who exact tool-locks a resource@version) for closure checks
commands.doctor: platform-local read-only state report (lives per platform under ops/; this package standardizes the contract)
commands.invocation_matrix: the /wf and /wfa invocable-surface matrix over the shared registries (prepare->next->stop, FAIL 0 = interface face complete). --config is required and there is no platform default; --out parents are created; run names are stamped per invocation; --print-digest pins this harness version.

coversGates: D-10/D-14/D-17/D-18 acceptance harness shared and versioned
